comparison.objective: Mount a press light curtain at its ISO 13855 safety distance; candidate adjusts and commissions a robot-axis shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests positioning and mounting a safety sensor at a calculated distance; candidate tests recessed hex-key engagement, bimanual collar adjustment, bounded locking torque, and iterative impact tuning.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires the mounted curtain at the prescribed safety distance; candidate requires two safe dynamic stops and no post-lock setting drift.
comparison.reason: Both may include positioning and fastening, but the essential tested outcomes are safety-distance installation versus dynamic energy-control tuning. No spec versions, target distance, fastening procedure, or tolerance are present.
